INSERT INTO TB_ATT_EMP_IDCARD_M (ID_CARD_NO, EMPLOYEE_NO, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, VENDOR_CODE, CREATION_USER_ID, CREATION_DATE) select trim(li.attribute1) in_card_no ,trim(li.attribute2) employee_no ,TO_DATE(trim(li.attribute3), 'DD/MM/YYYY') effective_start_date ,TO_DATE(trim(li.attribute4), 'DD/MM/YYYY') effective_end_date ,trim(li.attribute5) vendor_code ,#{applicationUserId} AS CREATION_USER_ID ,SYSDATE
from lgcom_import_n li
where li.session_id = #{sessionId}
and li.seq_no > 1
and not exists (select 'Y'
from tb_att_emp_idcard_m ei
where ei.id_card_no = trim(li.attribute4) )
